messages:
sam: alert — hosted-infer/us-west p99 latency > 2.5s and 5xx rate jumped to 6.4% in last 5m, multiple customers affected
infra-bot: SLO burn detected: hosted-infer/us-west p99>2s for 5m (alert id: sb-46712)
priya: seeing same on our dashboard, customers reporting timeouts and 502s in support queue
alex: any auth failures? if tokens are failing we might be getting retry storms that amplify load
support-engineer: customer ticket #7892 reporting repeated 502s, attached request id and headers
sam: quick top-level query: `logs | where service==\"hosted-infer\" and status>=500 | count by path, upstream` → spike concentrated on `/v1/complete` and upstream `auth-proxy`
devon: tracing: there are gaps between gateway -> auth-proxy -> infer-worker, sampling dropped right when the spike started
priya: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/hosted-infer/overview (look at error heatmap + per-upstream error rate)
alex: run this SQL-ish query against logs store to confirm:
```
SELECT upstream, status, count(*) as cnt
FROM logs
WHERE service = 'hosted-infer' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY upstream, status
ORDER BY cnt DESC
```
priya: query shows `auth-proxy` 502/504 and `infer-worker` 500s with `context deadline exceeded` in runtime logs
sam: might be KMS/key rotation affecting auth-proxy cache -> intermittent 401s -> retries -> overload
support-engineer: customer mentioned they launched a large batch job at ~10:12 UTC that coincides with the spike
devon: trying repro with `ab -n 10000 -c 200` against /v1/complete with bearer token loop, seeing upstream timeouts after ~200 req/s (local repro ok)
alex: mitigation suggestion: enable fallback-routing to small-variant model, throttle prefetch, and temporarily raise per-customer rate limit for bursty customers to avoid head-of-line blocking
sam: pushed routing change to canary: fallback to model-sm at edge for hosted-infer/us-west; disabled prefetching for that route
priya: escalated to infra and support, creating incident INC-2026 with notes and initial timeline
support-engineer: I'll update customer with workaround steps and ask for request-ids + exact timestamps
devon: increased trace sampling for hosted-infer to 100% for 15m to capture full spans and fill gaps
alex: checking auth-proxy cache metrics: hit-rate dropped at 10:11 UTC, backend KMS reported a short error window 10:10–10:13 UTC
sam: monitoring — 5xx down to 0.9% and p99 back to ~1.1s after fallback and throttles
priya: keeping incident open for 1h of stable metrics, will run postmortem if it recurs
support-engineer: saved logs link: s3://redwood-logs/hosted-infer/2026-03-15/ and incident doc https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/INC-2026
sam: thanks all, great response :thumbsup:
